profile.name: Regio Dani Pangestu
profile.tagline: Software that keeps working after launch
profile.bio: I design and build the systems small and mid-sized businesses run on — ordering and inventory, bookings, customer support, and the automation in between. One engineer from first conversation to production, so nothing gets lost in handover.
profile.title: Full-Stack Engineer
highlights: Every release ships with a rollback plan
You own the code, the data, and the infrastructure — no lock-in

projects.title: Jam Nguar
projects.tagline: Room booking for Blitar Regency government staff.
projects.description: Staff book meeting rooms against real availability, with booking deadlines, VIP room rules, and conflicts caught before two people can claim the same slot. A QR code at the door confirms who actually turned up.
projects.metrics: Handles booking conflicts so two people can never hold the same room

projects.title: Inven Kabupaten Blitar
projects.tagline: Inventory and ledger for regional government stock.
projects.description: Regional stock is reconciled against what actually moved, so the books match the shelves. Corrections are recorded instead of overwritten, and a negative balance shows up the moment it happens rather than at year end.
projects.metrics: Every stock correction is written to an audit trail

projects.title: Labtu
projects.tagline: Task and milestone tracking for government teams.
projects.description: Daily checklists, duty catalogues, and recaps for a government division, so work in progress is visible without chasing anyone for a status update.
projects.metrics: Replaced spreadsheet tracking for a whole division

projects.title: CS Portal
projects.description: Customer support runs over WhatsApp: routine questions are answered from the business's own knowledge base, staff take over any conversation that needs a person, and plans are billed from the same place.
projects.metrics: Support keeps running when staff are offline

projects.title: Afsa Tour & Transport
projects.tagline: Tour packages and transport rental, Blitar.
projects.description: A catalogue of tour packages and rental vehicles, with enquiries that reach the owner directly instead of piling up in a mailbox.
projects.metrics: Enquiries land in WhatsApp instead of an inbox nobody reads

projects.title: Plantea
projects.description: A storefront for rare plants built to serve fast: pages are generated ahead of time rather than assembled on every visit, so a catalogue page opens without waiting on a server.
projects.metrics: Pages load without a backend round-trip
